graph.title: Aira's Creative Workshop
notes: The L3 'separate groups' check is not a real problem here, so I kept the groups apart. The booklet builds separate models, shown on its pages 3, 4, 10, 11 and 22. These are the workshop desk (b1-b32), the step stool (b33-b37, built at step 13 on page 10 as its own mini-model), the arch/bird stand (b38-b71 plus the two wing arms), and Aira's wing pack (b72-b84). The cover and page 25 show them as separate models. No step joins any of them to another, so there are no real edges to add.

The remaining two groups are b85 (round trans-purple tile) and b86 (map tile). Page 3 shows them held in the minifigure's hands, not attached to any LEGO part. The minifigure's own pieces are not in the inventory, so there is no node to connect them to. They stay as standalone nodes and I did not invent a join.
The parts list has 94 pieces. The wing-arm sub-assembly from steps 13 and 14 (4 pieces each) is a repeat (8 pieces). So b1-b86 plus the 8 repeat parts make 94.

Many exact stud positions are not visible in the small step pictures. Most stud-to-stud joins therefore use null ports, and the choice of supporting brick is a best reading of the images. The same applies to the bracket b21 under the white beam, the 1x4 plate b67 on the base plate, and the slopes and columns on b45/b44/b46.
The wing arms hinge on the headlight-brick side holes (b58/b59, port stud.side), modelled as revolute joints. Their bars use the port bar.1.
The letter tile b70 stands loose in the two corner panels, so it has contact edges only.
Plume b81 is attached to the T-piece end and plume b82 to a magenta clip plate. The wing bars go into the gold clip tiles. This is a best reading of steps 6 and 7 on pages 23-24.

The wing arms hinge on the headlight-brick side holes (b58/b59, stud.side), modelled as revolute joints. Their bars are modelled as ports bar.1.
The letter tile (b70) stands loose in the two corner panels, so it has contact edges only.
Plume b81 is attached to the T-piece end and plume b82 to a magenta clip plate. The wing bars go into the gold clip tiles. This is a best reading of step 6 and step 7 on pages 23-24.
